@vinext/cloudflare@1.0.1.why: createCacheFacingRequest (dist/cache/cdn-adapter.worker.js) left redirect at "follow", so a cacheable page that redirects loops inside the Worker until it becomes a 500 "Too many redirects". The patch sets redirect: "manual".
@vinext/cloudflare@1.0.1.notes: Removable once a @vinext/cloudflare release newer than 1.0.1 carries the fix. Added 06673ef3, re-pointed e1877fb1.

react@19.2.8.why: workerd defines console.createTask but it throws, so `vinext dev` 500s. The patch disables createTask when navigator.userAgent is "Cloudflare-Workers". Dev-only.
react@19.2.8.notes: TASK-294, added cf793e32. Removable when EITHER vinext ships the fallback (PR 3233, in a vinext release) OR workerd implements createTask (issues 6408, 6488). Keep in step with react-dom and react-server-dom-webpack.

react-dom@19.2.8.why: Same createTask guard as the react patch, applied to react-dom: workerd's console.createTask throws, so `vinext dev` 500s. Dev-only.
react-dom@19.2.8.notes: TASK-294, added cf793e32. Remove together with the react and react-server-dom-webpack patches.

react-server-dom-webpack@19.3.0.why: Same createTask guard as the react patch, applied to react-server-dom-webpack: workerd's console.createTask throws, so `vinext dev` 500s. Dev-only.
react-server-dom-webpack@19.3.0.notes: TASK-294, added cf793e32. Remove together with the react and react-dom patches.
